entities.summary: Daniel Taylor is a Belarusian Canadian retired professional ice hockey goaltender. He was drafted in the seventh round of the 2004 NHL Entry Draft by the Los Angeles Kings and has appeared in four NHL games with the Kings, Calgary Flames, and Ottawa Senators.
